attanā coday'attānaṃ, paṭimaṃsetha attanā, so attagutto satimā, sukhaṃ bhikkhu vihāhisi.

yaṃ hi'ssa, bhante, vīriyaṃ tadassa vīriy'indriyaṃ.
sārattā kāmabhogesu, giddhā kāmesu mucchitā, atisāraṃ na bujjhanti, macchā khippaṃ'va oḍḍitaṃ, pacchā'saṃ kaṭukaṃ hoti, vipāko hissa pāpako'ti.
akāro dīgham'āpajjate hi mi ma'icc'etesu vibhattīsu. gacchāhi, gacchāmi, gacchāma, gacchāmhe. mikāraggahaṇena hivibhattimhi akāro kvaci na dīgham'āpajjate. gacchahi.
hivibhatti lopam'āpajjate vā. gaccha, gacchāhi, gama, gamāhi, gamaya, gamayāhi. hī'ti kim'atthaṃ? gacchati, gamayati.
na brāhmaṇass'etadakiñci seyyo, yadā nisedho manaso piyehi, yato yato hiṃsamano nivattati, tato tato sammati'm'eva dukkhaṃ.

71308.commentary: (THa) ahiṃsako'ti me nāmaṃ, hiṃsakassa pure sato'ti satthārā samāgamato pubbe hiṃsakassa me samānassa ahiṃsako'ti nāmamattaṃ ahosi.

na tena ariyo hoti, yena pāṇāni hiṃsati, ahiṃsā sabbapāṇānaṃ, ariyo'ti pavuccati.

na brāhmaṇass'etadakiñci seyyo, yadā nisedho manaso piyehi, yato yato hiṃsamano nivattati, tato tato sammati'm'eva dukkhaṃ.

71318.meaning2: having caused to hurt or injure

yato sarāmi attānaṃ, yato patto'smi viññutaṃ, n'ābhijānāmi sañcicca, ekapāṇam'pi hiṃsitaṃ.
nam'atthi ūnaṃ kāmehi, hiṃsitā me na vijjati, amanussavaco sutvā, tasm'āhaṃ na gahe rame.

71323.meaning2: having hurt, having injured, having teased

examples.text: so atthi idaṃ, atthi hīnaṃ, atthi paṇītaṃ, atthi imassa saññāgatassa uttariṃ nissaraṇan'ti pajānāti.
passāmi loke pariphandamānaṃ, pajaṃ imaṃ taṇhagataṃ bhavesu, hīnā narā maccumukhe lapanti, avītataṇhāse bhav'ābhavesu.
yam'assa vādaṃ parihīnam'āhu, apāhataṃ pañhavimaṃsakāse, paridevati socati hīnavādo, upaccagā man'ti anutthunāti.
sace cuto sīlavatato hoti, pavedhatī kamma virādhayitvā, pajappatī patthayatī ca suddhiṃ, satthā'va hīno pavasaṃ gharamhā.
yāh'ayaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, rati, aññatr'eva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi, api dibbaṃ sukhaṃ samadhigayha tiṭṭhati, tāya ratiyā ramamāno hīnassa na pihemi, na tattha abhiramāmi.
yato kho, nigrodha, tapassī cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto hoti, aduṃ c'assa hoti tapassitāya. so abhiharati no hīnāy'āvattati.
coditā devadūtehi, ye pamajjanti māṇavā, te dīgharattaṃ socanti, hīnakāy'ūpagā narā.
hīnaṃ kāyaṃ upapannā bhavanto, anānulomā bhavat'ūpapatti, duddiṭṭharūpaṃ vata addasāma, sahadhammike hīnakāy'ūpapanne.

71331.meaning1: low-born; of low caste; of humble origin

71332.meaning1: family of low birth; poor family

examples.text: atha ca pan'āhaṃ na vadāmi, yasmā vaṇṇā añño vaṇṇo uttaritaro vā paṇītataro vā n'atthī'ti. atha ca pana tvaṃ, udāyi, yv'āyaṃ vaṇṇo kiminā khajjopanakena hīnataro ca patikiṭṭhataro ca so paramo vaṇṇo'ti vadesi, tañ'ca vaṇṇaṃ na paññapesī'ti.

71334.meaning1: who aims for an inferior goal; with low aspirations; (comm) of low mentality
71334.commentary: (SNa) hīn'attarūpā na pāraṃ gamā te'ti hīn'attasabhāvā te nibbānaṅgamā na honti. hīn'attharūpā'ti'pi pāṭho, hīn'atthajātikā parihīn'atthā'ti attho. (SNt) hīn'attarūpā'ti hīn'ādhimuttikatāya nihīnacittasabhāvā.

examples.text: pañcavedā sataṃ samaṃ, tapassī brāhmaṇā caraṃ, cittañ'ca nesaṃ na sammā vimuttaṃ, hīn'attharūpā na pāraṅ'gamā te.

71335.commentary: (DNa) hīn'ādīsu hīnā dhātū'ti dvādasa akusalacitt'uppādā. avasesā tebhūmakadhammā majjhimadhātu. nava lok'uttaradhammā paṇītadhātu.

examples.text: aparā'pi tisso dhātuyo, hīnadhātu, majjhimadhātu, paṇītadhātu.

71336.meaning1: coarse and refined; inferior and superior

examples.text: ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? atthi, bhikkhave, kusal'ākusalā dhammā, sāvajj'ānavajjā dhammā, hīnapaṇītā dhammā, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā.

71337.meaning2: fact of being coarse and refined; fact of being inferior and superior

examples.text: tatr'āvuso, yv'āyaṃ puggalo sāṅgaṇo'va samāno atthi me ajjhattaṃ aṅgaṇan'ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, ayaṃ imesaṃ dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ sāṅgaṇānaṃ'y'eva sataṃ hīnapuriso akkhāyati.

71339.meaning1: coarse and refined; inferior and superior

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo andho? idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa tathārūpaṃ cakkhu na hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigaccheyya adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātikareyya, tathārūpam'pi'ssa cakkhu na hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā kusal'ākusale dhamme jāneyya, sāvajj'ānavajje dhamme jāneyya, hīnappaṇīte dhamme jāneyya, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāge dhamme jāneyya.

71340.meaning1: fact of being inferior and superior; coarse and refined state
71340.commentary: (MNa) yadidaṃ hīnappaṇītatāyā'ti yaṃ idaṃ tvaṃ hīno bhava, tvaṃ paṇīto, tvaṃ app'āyuko, tvaṃ dīgh'āyuko… tvaṃ duppañño bhava, tvaṃ paññavā'ti evaṃ hīnappaṇītatāya vibhajanaṃ, taṃ na añño koci karoti, kammam'eva evaṃ satte vibhajatī'ti attho.

examples.text: ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu ko paccayo yena manussānaṃ'y'eva sataṃ manussabhūtānaṃ dissanti hīnappaṇītatā'ti?

71342.commentary: (DNa) hīnasammatan'ti mante dhārenti mante vācentī'ti kho, vāseṭṭha, idaṃ tena samayena hīnasammataṃ.

examples.text: na dān'ime jhāyantī'ti kho, vāseṭṭha, ajjhāyakā ajjhāyakā tv'eva tatiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ. hīnasammataṃ kho pana, vāseṭṭha, tena samayena hoti, tadeta'r'ahi seṭṭhasammataṃ.
yam'assa vādaṃ parihīnam'āhu, apāhataṃ pañhavimaṃsakāse, paridevati socati hīnavādo, upaccagā man'ti anutthunāti.

71345.meaning1: low in energy; lacking in endurance; unenergetic; weak; feeble
71345.commentary: (MNa) hīnavīriyā'ti hīnā vīriyena virahitā viyuttā, nibbīriyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: subh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu asaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi c'āmattaññuṃ, kusītaṃ hīnavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve pasahati māro, vāto rukkhaṃ'va dubbalaṃ.
ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kusītā hīnavīriyā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, kusītahīnavīriyasandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

71346.meaning1: inferior disposition; bad inclination; low tendency

examples.text: adhimutti ajjhāsayadhātu. sā duvidhā hīn'ādhimutti paṇīt'ādhimuttī'ti. yāya hīn'ādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttikeyeva sevanti, paṇītādhimuttikā ca paṇīt'ādhimuttike'y'eva.

71347.meaning1: with inferior disposition; with bad inclination; with low tendencies
71347.commentary: (ITIa) hīn'ādhimuttikā'ti hīne kāmaguṇ'ādike adhimutti etesan'ti hīn'ādhimuttikā, hīn'ajjhāsayā.

examples.text: hīn'ādhimuttikā hīn'ādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti, kalyāṇ'ādhimuttikā kalyāṇ'ādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti.

71348.meaningLit: discourse on those of inferior disposition

71349.meaning1: reverted back to lay-life; returned to the secular world

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ūmibhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvatto. ūmibhayan'ti kho, bhikkhave, kodh'ūpāyāsass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ūmibhayaṃ.

71350.meaning1: reverts back to lay-life; returns to the secular world

examples.text: so kupito anattamano sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ūmibhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvatto.
so rāg'ānuddhaṃsena cittena maraṇaṃ vā nigacchati maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ. maraṇañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yo sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati.

71351.meaning1: reverted back to lay-life; returned to the secular world

examples.text: sappasir'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. abhiramat'āyasmā brahmacariye, m'āyasmā sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattī'ti.
tena hi tvaṃ ito paṭṭhāya kāyadvāraṃ vacīdvāraṃ manodvāranti tīṇi dvārāni rakkha, mā kāyena pāpakammaṃ kari, mā vācāya, mā manasā. gaccha mā hīnāy'āvatti, imāni tīṇi'y'eva sīlāni rakkhā'ti.

71352.meaning1: to go back to lay life; to return to the secular world
71352.meaningLit: to return to the low life

examples.text: yathā bhagavā aññāsi, abhabbo kho raṭṭhapālo kulaputto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattitun'ti, atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ raṭṭhapālaṃ etadavoca, yassa'dāni tvaṃ, raṭṭhapāla, kālaṃ maññasī'ti.

71353.meaning1: having reverted back to lay-life; having returned to the secular world
71353.meaningLit: having gone back to the low

examples.text: kiṃ nu kho tumhe āyasmanto atibāḷhaṃ mayi byāvaṭā yāva idān'āhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattissāmī'ti. so sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattitvā evam'āha, idāni kho tumhe āyasmanto attamanā hothā'ti?
sakkā bhoge ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātuṃ. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ puññāni ca kareyyan'ti.

ye hi keci, soṇa, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā aniccena viññāṇena dukkhena vipariṇāmadhammena seyyo'ham'asmī'ti vā samanupassanti, sadiso'ham'asmī'ti vā samanupassanti, hīno'ham'asmī'ti vā samanupassanti, kim'aññatra yathābhūtassa adassanā?
hīno'ham'asmī'ti vā samanupassanti, kim'aññatra yathābhūtassa adassanā?

71356.meaning1: I am worse; I am inferior
71356.commentary: (ADHa) hīno'ham'asmī'ti māno'ti lāmak'aṭṭhena ahaṃ hīno'ti evaṃ uppannamāno.

examples.text: tisso vidhā, seyyo'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, sadiso'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, hīno'ham'asmī'ti vidhā.
evam'pi viggayha vivādayanti, bālo paro akusalo'ti c'āhu, sacco nu vādo katamo imesaṃ, sabb'eva h'īme kusalā vadānā.
yam'āhu dhammaṃ paraman'ti eke, tam'eva hīnan'ti pan'āhu aññe, sacco nu vādo katamo imesaṃ, sabb'eva h'īme kusalā vadānā.
passanti devā ca tathāgatā ca, lokasmiṃ bālaṃ visamaṃ carantaṃ, tasmā hi att'ādhipateyyako ca, lok'ādhipo ca nipako ca jhāyī, dhamm'ādhipo ca anudhammacārī, na hīyati saccaparakkamo muni.
yamhi paccaye pare dā dhā mā ṭhā hā pā maha matha icc'evam'ādīnaṃ dhātūnaṃ anto īkāram'āpajjate. dīyati, dhīyati, mīyati, ṭhīyati, hīyati, pīyati, mahīyati, mathīyati.
nivatth'avatthen'eva gehato nikkhamitvā paramasallekhavuttiko'pi abalabalo amandamando viya paresaṃ acittakarūpena hīḷitaparibhūto hutvā gāmanigamarājadhānīsu ekarattivāsen'eva vicarati.
kāmadadassā'pi, mahārāja, maṇiratanassa ekadesaṃ kakkasaṃ uppajjati, na ca tattha kakkas'uppannattā maṇiratanaṃ hīḷitaṃ nāma hoti. yaṃ tattha parisuddhaṃ maṇiratanassa, taṃ janassa hāsakaraṃ hoti.
sa pattapāṇi vicaranto, amūgo mūgasammato, appaṃ dānaṃ na hīḷeyya, dātāraṃ n'āvajāniyā.

71373.meaning2: having scorned, having disdained, having despised

71376.grammar: masc, agent, in comps, from hanati
71376.notes: (MW) bhrūṇahan one who kills a learned Brāhman

examples.text: duddiṭṭhaṃ vata, bho bhāradvāja, addasāma, duddiṭṭhaṃ vata, bho bhāradvāja, addasāma! ye mayaṃ tassa bhoto gotamassa bhūnahuno seyyaṃ addasāmā'ti.
sammukhā ce'pi mayaṃ, bho bhāradvāja, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ passeyyāma, sammukhā'pi naṃ vadeyyāma, bhūnahu samaṇo gotamo'ti. taṃ kissa hetu? evañ'hi no sutte ocaratī'ti.
yaññe vā yadi vā saddhe, huññaṃ katvā yath'ārahaṃ, pasannacitto yajati, sukhette brahmacārisu.

71379.commentary: (ANa) yiṭṭhaṃ vuccati mahāyogo. hutan'ti paheṇakasakkāro adhippeto. tam'pi ubhayaṃ phal'ābhāvam'eva sandhāya paṭikkhipati.

examples.text: māse māse sahassena, yo yajetha sataṃ samaṃ, ekañ'ca bhāvit'attānaṃ, muhuttam'api pūjaye, sā'y'eva pūjanā seyyo, yañ'ce vassasataṃ hutaṃ.
sammādiṭṭhiko hoti aviparītadassano atthi dinnaṃ atthi yiṭṭhaṃ atthi hutaṃ atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko atthi ayaṃ loko atthi paro loko atthi mātā atthi pitā atthi sattā opapātikā

71380.meaningLit: burnt in fire as an offering

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci yiṭṭhaṃ va hutaṃ va loke, saṃvaccharaṃ yajetha puññapekkho, sabbam'pi taṃ na catubhāgam'eti, abhivādanā ujugatesu seyyo.
micchādiṭṭhiko hoti viparītadassano, n'atthi dinnaṃ, n'atthi yiṭṭhaṃ, n'atthi hutaṃ, n'atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, n'atthi ayaṃ loko, n'atthi paro loko
bhavanā abhinikkhamma, addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ, indīvaraṃ'va jalitaṃ, ādittaṃ'va hut'āsanaṃ.
yamhā dhammaṃ vijāneyya, sammāsambuddhadesitaṃ, sakkaccaṃ taṃ namasseyya, aggihuttaṃ'va brāhmaṇo.
na vissase ekatiyesu evaṃ, agārisu pabbajitesu c'āpi, sādhū'pi hutvā na asādhu honti, asādhu hutvā puna sādhu honti.
kulāni ca tena duṭṭhānī'ti pubbe saddhā hutvā taṃ āgamma assaddhā honti, pasannā hutvā appasannā honti.
atha, bhante, brahmā sanaṅkumāro oḷārikaṃ attabhāvaṃ abhinimminitvā kumāravaṇṇī hutvā pañcasikho devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ pāturahosi.

ayaṃ pan'ettha saṅkhepo, bhagavato kira bhikkhusaṅghassa ca pañcannaṃ mahānadīnaṃ mah'oghasadise lābhasakkāre uppanne hatalābhasakkārā aññatitthiyā sūriy'uggamanakāle khajjopanakā viya nippabhā hutvā ekato sannipatitvā mantayiṃsu.
laddhā hi so upādānaṃ, mahā hutvāna pāvako, so āsajja ḍahe bālaṃ, naraṃ nāriñ'ca ekadā.
oraṃ samuddassa atittarūpo, pāraṃ samuddassa'pi patthayetha, rājā ca aññe ca bahū manussā, avītataṇhā maraṇaṃ upenti, ūnā'va hutvāna jahanti dehaṃ, kāmehi lokamhi na hatthi titti.
evaṃ vutte, bhikkhave, upako ājīvako hupeyya'p'āvuso'ti vatvā sīsaṃ okampetvā ummaggaṃ gahetvā pakkāmi.

71388.meaning2: in the other world, in another existence

examples.text: tato tvaṃ bāhiya na tena. yato tvaṃ bāhiya na tena tato tvaṃ bāhiya na tattha. yato tvaṃ bāhiya na tattha tato tvaṃ bāhiya n'ev'idha na huraṃ na ubhayam'antarena
yass'ūbhay'ante paṇidh'īdha n'atthi, bhav'ābhavāya idha vā huraṃ vā, nivesanā tassa na santi keci, dhammesu niccheyya samuggahītaṃ.

71389.commentary: (NIDD2) huraṃ gotamasāsanā'ti huraṃ gotamasāsanā paraṃ gotamasāsanā pure gotamasāsanā paṭhamataraṃ gotamasāsanā

examples.text: ye me pubbe viyākaṃsu, huraṃ gotamasāsanā, icc'āsi iti bhavissati, sabbaṃ taṃ itih'ītihaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ takkavaḍḍhanaṃ, n'āhaṃ tattha abhiramiṃ.

71390.meaning1: from here to there; from one place to another
71390.commentary: (UDa) hurā huraṃ dhāvati bhantacitto'ti appahīnam'icchāvitakkattā anavaṭṭhitacitto kadāci rūpe, kadāci sadde'ti-ādinā tasmiṃ tasmiṃ ārammaṇe assād'ādi-vasena apar'āparaṃ dhāvati paribbhamati.

examples.text: manujassa pamattacārino, taṇhā vaḍḍhati māluvā viya, so plavatī hurā huraṃ, phalam'icchaṃ'va vanasmi vānaro.

71391.meaning1: from life to life; from existence to existence; from here to there
71391.commentary: (DHPa) so plavatī hurā huran'ti so taṇhāvasiko puggalo bhave bhave uplavati dhāvati. (UDa) atha vā hurā huraṃ dhāvati bhantacitto'ti apariññātavitakkattā tannimittānaṃ avijjātaṇhānaṃ vasena paribbhamanamānaso idhalokato paralokaṃ ādānanikkhepehi apar'āparaṃ dhāvati saṃsaratī'ti attho.

examples.text: manujassa pamattacārino, taṇhā vaḍḍhati māluvā viya, so plavatī hurā huraṃ, phalam'icchaṃ'va vanasmi vānaro.
evaṃ vutte, bhikkhave, upako ājīvako huveyya'p'āvuso'ti vatvā sīsaṃ okampetvā ummaggaṃ gahetvā pakkāmi.

hū'icc'etassa dhātussa saro eha oha ettam'āpajjate bhavissantimhi, ssassa ca lopo hoti vā. hehiti, hehinti, hohiti, hohinti, heti, henti, hehissati, hehissanti, hohissati, hohissanti, hessati, hessanti. hūti kim'atthaṃ? bhavissati, bhavissanti. bhavissantimhī'ti kim'atthaṃ? hoti.
he je kāḷī'ti. kiṃ, ayye'ti? kiṃ, je, divā uṭṭhāsī'ti?
yaṃ taṃ apucchimha akittayī no, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāma tadiṅgha brūhi, ettāvat'aggaṃ nu vadanti h'eke, yakkhassa suddhiṃ idha paṇḍitāse, udāhu aññam'pi vadanti etto.
dadanti h'eke visame niviṭṭhā, chetvā vadhitvā atha socayitvā, sā dakkhiṇā assumukhā sadaṇḍā, samena dinnassa na aggham'eti.
adh'akkhakan'ti heṭṭh'akkhakaṃ. ubbhajāṇumaṇḍalan'ti uparijāṇumaṇḍalaṃ.
